defaultBranch: Branch to link to first. When empty, the remote default branch, then main, then master. Falls back to the current branch when the file isn't there.
defaultRemote: The git remote the links point at.
repositoryType: The host that the links are built for.
repoAuto: Read the host from the remote URL. Hosts other than bitbucket.org and gitlab.com get GitHub links
repoBitbucketServer: Bitbucket Server and Data Center, with /projects/<project>/repos/<repo> links
remoteURLMapping: Swaps the web URL of a remote for another URL in the links, such as {"https://mirror.github.com": "https://github.com"}.
